channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — Mathematics
channel.description: Free mathematics study notes and revision guide with worked examples covering algebra, analysis, geometry, and more.

item.title: Groups and Subgroups
item.description: Definition of groups, examples of common groups, subgroups, subgroup tests, and closure properties with worked exercises.

item.title: Normal Subgroups and Quotient Groups
item.description: Normal subgroups, coset decomposition, quotient groups, and the first isomorphism theorem with detailed proofs.

item.title: Vector Spaces and Linear Independence
item.description: Axioms of vector spaces, spanning sets, linear independence, bases, dimension, and the replacement theorem.

item.title: Eigenvalues and Diagonalisation
item.description: Characteristic polynomial, algebraic and geometric multiplicity, diagonalisation conditions, and applications to matrix powers.

item.title: Sequences and Limits
item.description: Convergence of sequences, monotone convergence theorem, Bolzano-Weierstrass theorem, and Cauchy sequences with epsilon-delta proofs.

item.title: Continuity and Differentiation
item.description: Continuous functions on metric spaces, differentiability, the mean value theorem, and L'Hopital's rule with rigorous proofs.

item.title: Partial Derivatives and the Chain Rule
item.description: Partial derivatives, directional derivatives, gradient vectors, and the multivariable chain rule with worked examples.

item.title: First Order Differential Equations
item.description: Separable equations, exact equations, integrating factors, and existence and uniqueness theorems for first order ODEs.

item.title: Complex Numbers and Functions
item.description: Complex plane, modulus and argument, Euler's formula, elementary complex functions, and the Cauchy-Riemann equations.

item.title: Modular Arithmetic and Congruences
item.description: Definition of congruence, Chinese remainder theorem, Fermat's little theorem, Euler's theorem, and applications to cryptography.

item.title: Probability Spaces and Random Variables
item.description: Axioms of probability, sigma-algebras, measurable spaces, discrete and continuous random variables, and probability mass and density functions.

item.title: Topological Spaces and Continuity
item.description: Open sets, topologies generated by bases, continuous functions between topological spaces, homeomorphisms, and Hausdorff spaces.

item.title: Lebesgue Measure and Integration
item.description: Lebesgue outer measure, measurable sets, the Lebesgue integral, convergence theorems, and comparison with Riemann integration.

item.title: Normed Vector Spaces and Banach Spaces
item.description: Norms, equivalence of norms, Banach spaces, bounded linear operators, the open mapping theorem, and the Hahn-Banach theorem.

item.title: Manifolds and Tangent Spaces
item.description: Smooth manifolds, charts and atlases, tangent vectors, the tangent bundle, and smooth maps between manifolds with worked examples.

item.title: Mathematics — Complete Guide
item.description: Free mathematics study notes covering abstract algebra, linear algebra, real analysis, multivariable calculus, ODEs, complex analysis, number theory, probability, topology, measure theory, functional analysis, and differential geometry.
